metadata.desc: A plugin for Maimai DX / Chunithm (China server) using Lxns API, supporting b50, bests, song info and more.

api_key.hint: Only needed when using Developer API Key mode

client_id.hint: Do not change unless you know what this is

redirect_uri.hint: Do not change unless you know what this is

rate_limit_interval.hint: Minimum interval between all LXNS API requests to prevent too high request rate; 0 disables it

clear_kv_on_terminate.hint: Delete all users' OAuth tokens and friend-code bindings (including historical data) when the plugin is unloaded or reloaded; kept by default

debug.hint: Enable to output more debug logs
